title: Will Armor
description: Will Armor is a mod that adds a new Archangel armor set. It features custom 3D armor with unique mechanics and effects.
body:
# Will Armor - Archangel's Vestments

A comprehensive Minecraft mod that adds a stunning **Archangel armor set** with custom 3D models, unique mechanics, and powerful effects.

## 🛡️ Features

### Armor & Customization
- Custom 3D Archangel armor with GeckoLib animations
- Animated wings on the chestplate
- Craftable Sacred Wings and Sacred Halo artifacts

### ⚡ Gameplay Effects
Wearing the full set grants:
- **+15 Health** - Enhanced durability
- **Regeneration I** - Constant recovery
- **Resistance I** - Damage reduction
- **Unlimited Flight** - No creative mode needed
- **Speed II While Flying** - Faster aerial movement

### 🔥 Enraged Mode
Press **Y** to activate a powerful rage ability:
- **Phase 1** (10s): Player debuffs (Blindness and Weakness)
- **Phase 2** (45s): Strength, resistance, absorption
- **Cooldown**: 300 seconds

### 📜 Progression
- 5 unique achievements to unlock
- Crafting recipes for all pieces
- Full localization (Russian & English)
- Configurable balance parameters

## 📥 Installation

1. Install Forge 47.4.10+
2. Install GeckoLib 4.7.3+
3. Place JAR in mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft

**Need help?** Check the GitHub repository for detailed build instructions.

## 🔧 Configuration

Edit `config/willarmor-common.toml` to customize:
- Rage duration and cooldown
- Health bonus amount

## 🐛 Issues & Support
